title: Liria 08 – The City of a Thousand Voices
summary: High above the streets of Novaris, Liria sat on a small rooftop terrace.
story:
High above the streets of Novaris, Liria sat on a small rooftop terrace.

Several notebooks, maps, and loose sheets covered in writing lay before her.

Below the terrace, the city was coming alive for the evening.

Merchants closed their shops. Craftspeople returned home. The first conversations rose from the taverns.

Liria studied her notes.

That day, she had spoken with a baker whose deliveries regularly arrived late.

A young craftsman had complained about the lack of workshops.

And a family had described how difficult the journey to the nearest school had become.

Each problem seemed insignificant on its own.

But Liria recognized a common pattern.

The city had grown faster than its infrastructure.

"You really have been busy," she murmured with a smile, gazing over the rooftops.

She unfolded a large map of the city.

With small marks, she indicated the places where residents had reported difficulties.

After a while, a clear picture emerged.

New residential districts needed better connections. Workshops required suitable spaces. And some public facilities had become too distant.

Liria leaned back.

She could solve these problems directly.

But that would not be the right way.

Instead, she wrote several recommendations for the responsible planners and administrative offices.

The residents should be able to shape their own city.

Her role was to recognize developments and help ensure that no one was overlooked.

When the first stars appeared in the sky, Liria set down her pen.

Thousands of windows glowed beneath her.

Behind each one was a story of its own.

And every one of those stories was part of Novaris.
